name: dsfd_wfc_lnk_e-e1-COMMIT
purpose: S81 sp_wfc link bridge dsfd_wfc_lnk re-planned for the one-face slot (contract v16: all sp_wfc die pins on E): same RTL as the closed mtp-wfc_lnk-b-0cd6caa1b-tc (module text sha-pinned in rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/closed_snap/manifest.json), outline 64.8 x 108 (the logic is 3.0k um2 of cells: the closed 216 x 151.2 was 10 % utilised, sized by its 513-b W / E / N faces; 108 um = the E face the slot has left over the 172.8-um VM-port tile on the 43.2-um child lattice); die link in AND out on E (1,030 pins), WFC in / out buses, credit, fault, clock and reset on W (toward the WFC), the unused DRAFT tap t_dw on N; layer cap M5 (the closed view routes to M7 and has its clock on S and the WFC buses on N: neither face has a channel when the tile sits over the VM-port tile at the slot's E face).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_wfc_lnk u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/dsfd_mtp_tops.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_link_pair.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_skid.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_seq.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_wfc_tok.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_wfc_lnk.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_wfc_vmx.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_drf_fan.sv rtl/common/ot_ratio_cdc_fifo.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_lnk_e/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_lnk_e/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_lnk_e --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_wfc_lnk  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: pin faces re-planned (die link both directions on E, WFC side on W) and layer cap M7 -> M5; RTL unchanged

reroute_reason.slot_change_request: el1011-s81die.log 2026-10-13 [el1013-s81-wfcstg -> s81die] sp_wfc cluster floorplan: every die pin of slot sp_wfc (contract results/arch/hier_contract_1011/s81.json v16) is on the slot's E face; the closed view mtp-wfc_lnk-b-0cd6caa1b-tc is a W -> E pass-through (f_lid on W, t_lod on E, WFC buses on N, clock on S, signals to M7) and cannot serve a one-face slot: f_lid would run ~520 um around the tile unregistered
